shared_elements: elaborate headdress or radiating plume-like elements
division of the field by a horizontal band
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures with what appear to be elaborate radiating headdresses or plumed ornaments, which is the most specific shared trait, but it is a very common convention. A shows sparse, thinly outlined figures spread across two horizontal registers separated by a band, whereas B shows a single dense, deeply modelled figure with a frontal face surrounded by tightly packed ornamental and sign-like motifs filling the whole field, so relationships, layout and rendering conventions differ substantially.
